Write a fictional, alternate version of the Lord's Prayer but it is set in an alternate future where society has collapsed and regressed back into feudalist times, and is worshipping the American founding fathers as gods Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced. Ensure each word in your response has at least one consonant cluster (two or more consonants together).assistant

Blessed be the Founding Fathers, our benevolent overlords, who have brought us low in this dark and troubled land! May their wisdom and virtue guide us, as we toil in the fields and forests, tilling the soil and tending the beasts.

What shall we pray for, O Great George, our Lord and King? Shall we ask for bread, that we may fill our bellies and warm our bones? Or shall we pray for shelter, that we may find refuge from the storms and the wolves?

Hark! What tidings bring us joy and comfort in these troubled times? Shall we rejoice at the thought of our noble forebears, who fought and died for our freedom and our way of life? Or shall we tremble with fear at the thought of the tyrants and oppressors, who seek to snuff out our light and our liberty?

Blessed be the Founding Fathers, who have given us the gift of liberty and the right to bear arms! May their spirit guide us, as we defend our homes and our families, against all who would seek to do us harm.

What shall we do, O Great Thomas, our Lord and Savior? Shall we strive to be like our noble forebears, who stood tall and proud in the face of adversity? Or shall we falter and fail, like the weak and the timid?
